eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus on Polymarket closely splits between 17°C (40%) and 16°C (39.8%) for Helsinki-Vantaa Airport's highest temperature today, reflecting Finnish Meteorological Institute (FMI) updates showing early morning readings near 14°C under a ridging high-pressure system advecting warmer continental air from the east via light easterly winds and mostly clear skies. ECMWF and GFS ensemble forecasts converge on afternoon peaks of 16–17°C, boosted by high solar insolation above May's climatological average of 14–15°C, but subtle divergences in boundary-layer mixing and thin high-cloud timing create uncertainty—potentially capping at 16°C or enabling brief 17°C surges. Hourly FMI observations through late afternoon will refine the peak as insolation peaks around 1600 local time.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus on Polymarket reflects tight uncertainty for São Paulo's May 16 high temperature, with 25–27°C outcomes leading at 28.5–32.0% implied probabilities amid divergent forecast models. INMET's latest guidance projects a conservative 23°C maximum under mostly clear skies, low humidity (30–85%), and light winds, while private forecasters like Climatempo and CNN indicate 25°C, aligned with ECMWF/GFS ensembles showing stronger afternoon heating from high-pressure subsidence. Differentiating factors include potential afternoon cloudiness from an approaching weak front, which could cap peaks at 25°C, versus fuller insolation pushing toward 27°C in the urban heat island of São Paulo—where official stations like Mirante de Santana measure highs. Recent May 15 observations hovered in the low 20s°C, but a warming trend post-cool spell drives the cluster; final model updates tonight could shift odds before resolution via INMET data.

eventMetadata.context_description: Latest ECMWF and GFS ensemble forecasts converge on a daytime high around 23-25°C for Istanbul on May 16, positioning 25°C or higher (44.5% market-implied odds) and exactly 24°C (30.5%) as leading outcomes amid model spread reflecting potential for enhanced solar heating under high-pressure influence.
